Class EnvironmentalMetricsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.metrics.EnvironmentalMetricsHelper
public final class EnvironmentalMetricsHelper extends Object

EnvironmentalMetricsHelper

Calculates Earth system boundaries, climate anomalies, biogeochemical cycles, and biosphere integrity indicators (atmospheric CO2, Arrhenius radiative forcing, Stull wet-bulb lethality, soil N-P-K stoichiometry, topsoil erosion, and forest cover).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • getAtmosphericCO2Ppm

      public double getAtmosphericCO2Ppm()
      Evaluates global atmospheric CO2 concentration (ppm) endogenously from the orbital/paleoclimatic carbon cycle baseline and cumulative anthropogenic land-use / fossil energy combustion (EPICA Dome C, Lüthi et al. 2008; Ruddiman 2003), with zero calendar-date hardcoding.
      Returns:
      atmospheric CO2 concentration in ppm

    • getTemperatureAnomaly

      public double getTemperatureAnomaly()
      Evaluates mean planetary temperature anomaly (°C) relative to 1850-1900 pre-industrial baseline via Arrhenius CO2 radiative forcing and cryospheric ice-albedo amplification (EPICA / PAGES 2k / IPCC AR6).
      Returns:
      global temperature anomaly in °C

    • getTopsoilErosionLossPct

      public double getTopsoilErosionLossPct()
      Evaluates Montgomery (2007) Cumulative Topsoil Erosion Loss (% of Holocene baseline).
      Returns:
      topsoil loss percentage in $[0.03, 85.0]$ %

    • getForestCoverRemainingPct

      public double getForestCoverRemainingPct()
      Evaluates HYDE 3.2 / FAO Global Forest Cover Remaining (% of post-glacial Holocene forest).
      Returns:
      forest retention percentage in $[0.0, 100.0]$ %

      Evaluates Vaclav Smil (2017) / Marchetti & Nakicenovic (1979) Fossil Fuel Share in Primary Energy (%).
